items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: I don't know him. I mean I did know his name.

ctx.x: No, I don't have his name. I don't know him. I mean I did know his name. We used to call him Papa. He was very old at that time.
So this is Peter Cuddy Consul number 13. Number 21. Number 21, yeah. Yeah, that's the Knights of Peter Fiverr.
What does that mean, Peter Cuddy Council? That was a priest's name, Peter Cuddy Council, Father Cuddy. Oh, I see. The council was named after him. That's a Catholic fraternal organization.
